commands.name: search-tide-stations
commands.summary: Search tide prediction stations by name (e.g. 'Boston'); returns station IDs, state, region and coordinates

commands.name: list-stations
commands.summary: List all CO-OPS stations offering a given product type (water levels, met, currents, current predictions, datums, harmonic constituents, etc.)

commands.name: get-station
commands.summary: Get metadata for one station by ID (name, location, timezone, flags) with optional expanded products, datums, details, notices, benchmarks

commands.name: get-station-datums
commands.summary: Get tidal datums for a station (MLLW, MHHW, MSL, NAVD88 etc.) plus LAT/HAT and record min/max

commands.name: get-station-sensors
commands.summary: List a station's sensors (water level, barometer, wind, temperature...) with status and elevation

commands.name: get-harmonic-constituents
commands.summary: Get tidal harmonic constituents (M2, S2, K1...) for a station: amplitude, phase, speed

commands.name: get-nearby-stations
commands.summary: List the stations nearest to a given station, with distance and station type

commands.name: get-tide-prediction-offsets
commands.summary: Get tide prediction offsets for a station (reference vs. subordinate, time/height offsets to its reference station)

commands.name: get-tide-predictions
commands.summary: Get tide predictions for a station: high/low times and heights or a regular time series, for a date or date range

commands.name: get-observations
commands.summary: Get observed data for a station: water levels, air/water temperature, wind, air pressure, humidity, visibility, conductivity, salinity, air gap

commands.name: get-current-predictions
commands.summary: Get tidal current predictions for a current station: max flood/ebb and slack times and speeds, or a time series

commands.name: list-tide-prediction-regions
commands.summary: Browse tide prediction geographic groups: top-level regions (lvl=4), states (lvl=5), or children of a parent group

commands.name: list-tide-prediction-group-stations
commands.summary: List the sub-areas and tide prediction stations inside a geographic group (e.g. a state such as 1403 = Massachusetts)

commands.name: list-current-prediction-groups
commands.summary: Get the full hierarchy of current prediction regions and their stations (coast > state > area > station with bin)

commands.name: list-ports-stations
commands.summary: List PORTS (Physical Oceanographic Real-Time System) stations with the sensors each provides

commands.name: get-data-inventory
commands.summary: Get a station's data inventory: which parameters it has measured and over what date ranges

commands.name: list-sea-level-trends
commands.summary: List relative sea level trends (inches/decade, period of record) for all US or global stations, or one station

commands.name: export-sea-level-trend-csv
commands.summary: Download a station's monthly mean sea level trend data as CSV (year, month, monthly MSL, linear trend, confidence bounds)

commands.name: list-storm-surge-events
commands.summary: List active storm surge / coastal inundation events (storm name, type, analysis, links)

commands.name: list-news
commands.summary: List recent NOAA Tides & Currents news posts
